method: Entire scope exact historical source text +34 lines, current source-first contracts and native interface review; CP287 mapped rows and historical B09-79–85 dispositions, CP292 complement empty for W1. No independent current AST replay.

groups.title: Legacy Reaction/Reset
groups.meaning: Direct direction result lookup; absent/falsy bridge_output enters legacy. Timed serialize with inclusive market bounds and deferred native published_reaction_candidate(direction,item,chronology); source selection owner retains native/public pairs and does not mutate detector geometry.

groups.title: Legacy payload builder
groups.meaning: Eight arrays in fixed insertion order reactions,resets,blueLines,aZones,sZones,eZones,stopAlls,orderAudit. Blue and A exact enabled gates; Blue receives bounds; S/E/StopAll pass through visibility without new flags or clipping. Legacy E audit key presence gate (not non-null); false returns empty.

groups.title: Legacy return
groups.meaning: Return timed builder immediately; no additive selection or projector invocation. Timing label direction.title; exceptions propagate.

groups.title: Additive shared selection
groups.meaning: One transform closure; select native/public reaction pairs and reset objects once in native order; serialize with non-null selected_items bypasses re-selection even if empty. Timed returns rows and same selection; destructure selected pair.

groups.title: Additive behavior selection
groups.meaning: Enabled Blue source indexes checked by _index_selected with market bounds; enabled A uses same visibility list, disabled fresh empty; S/E/StopAll reference current visibility lists. No recalculation.

groups.title: Additive audit selection
groups.meaning: Mapping get defaults None; non-null detector sorts prepared audit by first and break main-candle epochs, stable tie order; null returns empty. Distinct from legacy key-presence gate for malformed null entries.

groups.title: Additive legacy arrays
groups.meaning: Eight arrays same key order; Blue selected list passed without explicit bounds (helper accepts when either bound None). Audit serializer called only if audit_detector non-null; native serializer sorts emitted rows by firstTime/breakTime again. No guarantee of arbitrary malformed-state equivalence.

groups.title: Additive projection and return
groups.meaning: Build bridgeOutput from same selected native/public pairs, resets and behavior/audit objects plus direction/market/state/visibility; append ninth key. Return payload via timed builder; no projector on legacy path.

groups.title: Primary order conversion helpers
groups.meaning: stamp indexes market.candles directly, then epoch candle timestamp; no range guard. value dispatch datetime first then Decimal string, otherwise unchanged (shallow value conversion, not recursive).

groups.title: Primary order identity and causes
groups.meaning: Conceptual ownerDirection argument separate from physical order.direction. Types list fixed parent-stop->Order_A then reset-leg->Order_B membership; unrecognized causes omitted from types but preserved in causes. auditCauses list of new dicts preserving source cause/key iteration; convert only immediate values.

groups.title: Primary order geometry
groups.meaning: Physical First/Break and stop source/hit local indexes retained; candle timestamps from stamp, exact event timestamps directly epoch; required fields unguarded. stopLevel str; optional boxTop/Bottom null only if is None (zero string). causes list native order.

groups.title: Primary native reconciliation
groups.meaning: Import native PL_PH functions inside call. direction absent defaults bearish; exact bullish selects lows else highs, through visible end. index_offset absent defaults zero. cycles missing/falsy fallback singleton primary; first cycle ID from first element. Native resolves physical labels, not Bridge price decisions.

groups.title: Cycle ID offset
groups.meaning: If value and offset truthy, split on colon, transform only four parts with second exactly cycle, int-convert parts 2/3 and add offset; otherwise return original. No exception guard or recursive parsing.

groups.title: Point identity
groups.meaning: Relabel order through native final_primary. origin is truthy identity_source or item. ID uses direction, origin.kind/number and absolute origin trigger/decision offsets; append transformed origin cycle only if non-null and differs from first cycle. Identity differs from rendered item label.

groups.title: Point row
groups.meaning: Render item kind/number, local indexes, epoch recorded source/event times and candle-derived trigger/decision main times, str price. Order owner bearish iff item.kind PH else bullish, physical direction unchanged. Optional current cycleId if non-null. No quantization.

groups.title: Point range gate
groups.meaning: Select in input order only inclusive source range and decision<=end; no lower decision bound or trigger bound. Point conversion after filter.

groups.title: Visible and formed cycles
groups.meaning: Visible cycle requires non-null mbl and trigger<=end, independent of source range or confirmation. MBL rows independently iterate native formed_matching_legs through end, requiring first confirmed direction-main point, not merely visible activation.

groups.title: MBL identity and cap
groups.meaning: ID uses absolute reference StopAll and second behavior indexes; row indexes local. source epoch and str price. capTime source+400 candle timestamp if index<len, else last timestamp + timeframe*(source+400+1-len); note +1 extrapolation, no visible-end cap in this procedure.

groups.title: MBL event and stop horizon
groups.meaning: Trigger/confirmation main candle timestamp and recorded exact event separate. Each stop field tests non-null stop index and <=end; future/absent stop becomes null. Optional non-null cycle ID; append in native iterator order.

groups.title: Directional physical rows
groups.meaning: Bullish highs use original highs, lows resolved; otherwise highs resolved and lows original. Main side lows for bullish else highs. Main source map exact local index plus epoch source time, later duplicate overwrites.

groups.title: Cycle memberships
groups.meaning: For each main row gather original main point cycle IDs at equal index and epoch time, decision<=end and non-null ID, transform offset then dedup by dict.fromkeys encounter order. Not based on displayed cycle list.

groups.title: Cycle summary
groups.meaning: Visible activation cycles with non-null ID; render status unchanged and MBL indexes local, trigger timestamps. highCount always len(selected(cycle.highs)); main lowIds bullish/highIds otherwise use physical map matching source and end gate, dedup encounter order. Bullish lowCount len(selected(cycle.lows)); bearish counts displayed low rows with matching transformed cycleId. Count selection actually invokes point conversion; not just count predicate.

groups.title: Post-secondary3 orders
groups.meaning: Iterate visible cycles and post_pl3_orders in encounter order; skip stop_index>end (no None guard); no source range gate. Native relabel; conceptual owner bearish if bullish else bullish, optional cycle ID. No dedup.

groups.title: Status and output schema
groups.meaning: Horizon last visible candle open + timeframe. Last visible cycle status wins even without formed MBL; otherwise qualification non-null and strictly before horizon => waiting-for-stopall-break, else waiting-for-matching-behaviors. Return primaryHighs, primaryLows, matchingBehaviorLegs, primaryStatus, primaryCycles, directional postPH3Orders bullish/postPL3Orders otherwise. Local row indexes remain for later absolute projection.
